reports.title: First Advantage Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: Raising full year 2026 guidance ranges to Revenues of $1.720 billion to $1.745 billion, Adjusted EBITDA of $488 million to $498 million, Adjusted Net Income of $227 million to $232 million, and Adjusted Diluted Earnings Per Share of $1.30 to $1.332
